title: Crazy Painting / Mortar Compatibility
description: Adds the ability to use Mortar's dyes on Crazy Painting's palette for painting!
body:
## Description
Sometimes [painting](https://modrinth.com/mod/crazy-painting) with Minecraft's 16 dye colors isn't enough.  Sometimes you need [more dye colors](https://modrinth.com/mod/mortar) in your life. 

### Features:
- You can now add Mortar's dyes to Crazy Painting's palette for use when painting.
- Colors support all Crazy Painting operations (opacity, brush size, brush shape).

## Support
If you have a bug report, feature request, or any other type of issue, please post on our GitHub [issues page](https://github.com/DentedLeft/Dented-Modding/issues).  This is an issues page for all of our mods, so be sure to include the mod's name and version in your post.  We appreciate all feedback!

If you'd like to support development, you can leave a tip at our [BuyMeACoffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/dentedleft).  Only if it's within your means- otherwise, using, sharing, and enjoying the mod is support enough.  Thank you!

## Credits
*This project would not be possible without [Crazy Painting](https://modrinth.com/mod/crazy-painting) by omoflop and [Mortar](https://modrinth.com/mod/mortar) by Apollo.*
